s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic hypopigmented skin lesions with gradual coalescence and absence of hair growth
salient_findings: Multiple round, hypopigmented macules symmetrically distributed on face and neck
Absence of hair growth in affected areas
Lesions range from 2-3 mm to 25 mm in diameter
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 40s
2-year history of skin lesions
Lesions are asymptomatic
Lesions are round, hypopigmented macules
Lesions are symmetrically distributed on face and neck
Lesions have gradually coalesced
No hair growth at the site of the lesions
Previous treatment for tinea versicolor was unsuccessful
Histopathologic findings show plate-like subepidermal tumor
Neoplastic cords consist of clear/pale epithelial cells with glycogen accumulation
Stroma is formed by fibrous connective tissue
Marked elastosis is observed in dermis surrounding tumor

raw.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic hypopigmented skin lesions with gradual coalescence and absence of hair growth
salient_findings: Multiple round, hypopigmented macules symmetrically distributed on face and neck
Absence of hair growth in affected areas
Lesions range from 2-3 mm to 25 mm in diameter
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 40s
2-year history of skin lesions
Lesions are asymptomatic
Lesions are round, hypopigmented macules
Lesions are symmetrically distributed on face and neck
Lesions have gradually coalesced
No hair growth at the site of the lesions
Previous treatment for tinea versicolor was unsuccessful
Histopathologic findings show plate-like subepidermal tumor
Neoplastic cords consist of clear/pale epithelial cells with glycogen accumulation
Stroma is formed by fibrous connective tissue
Marked elastosis is observed in dermis surrounding tumor

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of multiple round, hypopigmented macules symmetrically distributed on the face and neck, along with the histopathologic findings of a plate-like subepidermal tumor and neoplastic cords consisting of clear/pale epithelial cells, is most consistent with dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria.

rejected.label: atrichia with papular lesions
rejected.why: The patient's lesions are described as hypopigmented macules, not papular lesions.

rejected.label: alopecia
rejected.why: While the patient has no hair growth at the site of the lesions, the primary presentation is of hypopigmented macules, not hair loss.

rejected.label: hypopigmentation
rejected.why: Hypopigmentation is a symptom, not a diagnosis, and does not explain the full range of the patient's presentation.

rejected.label: asymptomatic
rejected.why: Asymptomatic is a descriptor of the patient's condition, not a diagnosis.
